title: The Hospital That Used Cancer Patients as Nuclear Fuel Rods
hook: Doctors injected patients with plutonium to see how fast they'd die, then burned the bodies to measure radiation release.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines nuclear secrecy with medical betrayal—two high-curiosity zones that trigger disgust and the need to share.

title: The Vitamin Company That Sold Crushed Ant Eggs as 'Immune Boosters'
hook: CEO called it an 'ancient Amazonian secret.' Lab tests showed it was 98% formic acid and insect fragments.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'snake oil' trope gets a grotesque modern update—people love exposing wellness scams.

title: The Doctor Who Implanted Patients with Live Worms—for 'Detox'
hook: He claimed the worms ate disease. Patients' blood turned black with sepsis. He had 2,000 followers on social media.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bodily invasion and cult-like following creates visceral disgust and moral outrage—high shareability.

title: The Government That Gave Children TB on Purpose—to Test a Vaccine
hook: They infected 200 kids with tuberculosis, then gave half a fake vaccine. The other half simply died.
why_this_can_go_viral: Children as lab rats is a universal trigger. The explicit deception amplifies anger and demand for justice.

title: The Pharmaceutical Giant That Added Glass to Its Blood Pressure Pills
hook: Patients reported internal bleeding for years. The company knew the glass came from a broken grinder—and kept selling.
why_this_can_go_viral: Concrete physical danger in everyday medicine feels terrifyingly real—everyone takes pills.

title: The Hospital That Used Homeless People as Organ 'Donors'—Without Consent
hook: Patients admitted for minor ailments woke up missing a kidney. The hospital called it a 'clerical error.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic 'waking up missing an organ' nightmare combined with real systemic abuse drives deep engagement.

title: The FDA-Approved Asthma Inhaler That Repaired Lungs—by Growing Fungus
hook: The propellant fed a mold spore in the canister. Patients inhaled live fungus directly into their alveoli.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of 'breathing fungus daily' is viscerally horrifying and deeply ironic for an asthma drug.

title: The Surgeon Who Sewed Patients Shut with Fishing Line—and Called It 'Innovation'
hook: He saved money on surgical thread. Patients' wounds never healed. His license was revoked—after 15 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurd cheapness combined with the grotesque outcome creates a 'can't believe it's real' shock factor.

title: The Company That Painted Expired Pills with Food Coloring—and Sold Them as New
hook: Workers repainted 3-year-old drugs in a basement. The paint contained lead. Children ate them for months.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual deception (painted pills) and danger to children create a powerful 'this is evil' narrative.

title: The Clinic That Gave Patients Fake Vaccines—and Took Their Blood for Stem Cells
hook: They promised immunity. Instead, they drained patients' bone marrow and sold the stem cells on the black market.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines vaccine distrust and organ theft—two high-emotion topics that fuel intense discussion and sharing.

title: The Doctor Who Convinced an Entire Town They Had Cancer—to Bill Insurance
hook: He diagnosed 400 people with a rare cancer. None had it. He made $50 million before a whistleblower spoke.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an entire town being told they're dying for profit is both terrifying and outrageously cinematic.

title: The 'All-Natural' Cough Syrup That Was Pure Battery Acid
hook: Lab pH tested at 1.2. Six children died. The company called it a 'manufacturing anomaly.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The deadly contradiction between 'natural' and 'acid' creates cognitive dissonance and strong emotional response.

title: The Government That Gave Pregnant Women a 'Vitamin Drink'—It Was a Contraction Inducer
hook: They wanted to study preterm birth. Women who drank it went into labor within hours. 30 babies were born dead.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate betrayal—pregnant women trusting doctors and being given poison—generates maximum protective outrage.

title: The Drug Company That Sold Heroin as 'Toddler Teething Relief'
hook: It came in a 'baby-friendly' raspberry flavor. 50 infants were found dead before the FDA looked at the label.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of 'heroin' and 'toddlers' is one of the most emotionally charged triggers possible.

title: The Hospital That Faked MRI Results to Get Insurance Payouts
hook: They photoshopped tumors onto scans of healthy patients. 200 people received unnecessary chemo—and 30 died.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of being poisoned with chemo for a tumor that doesn't exist taps into deep medical anxiety.

title: The 'Gluten-Free' Bread That Was 100% Wheat—and Made Celiac Patients Bleed
hook: The factory put wheat flour in gluten-free wrappers. Patients ended up in the ER. The fine was $500.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable daily food fear—millions of gluten-free consumers will feel directly threatened and share.

title: The Doctor Who Used Patients' Skin for Leather Goods—and Sold Them Online
hook: He took extra skin during surgeries, tanned it, and made wallets. Police found 40 'pieces' in his home.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'human leather' concept is so macabre and surreal it forces people to click and share out of pure disbelief.

title: The Government That Sprayed a City with 'Flu Vaccine'—It Was a Sterility Agent
hook: The spray was aerosolized in a poor neighborhood. Within a year, 80% of women in that area were infertile.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mass sterilization conspiracy meets vaccine distrust—a perfect storm of controversy and shareability.

title: The Clinic That Told Patients They Had AIDS—and Sold Them 'Cure' Water
hook: They faked HIV tests, charged $10,000 for 'blessed' tap water, and told patients to stop real medication.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets the most vulnerable with a death sentence scam—rage and pity combine for high emotional sharing.

title: The Company That Sold Arsenic as 'Homeopathic Menopause Relief'
hook: The label said 'natural'. The ingredient list said 'arsenicum album'. 12 women died of heavy metal poisoning.
why_this_can_go_viral: Homeopathy vs. arsenic—the irony of 'natural' killing people is a powerful narrative hook.

title: The Government That Put Tuberculosis Bacteria in Infant Formula—as a 'Test'
hook: They wanted to see if babies would develop immunity. 100 infants got TB. 70 died. The rest were quarantined for life.
why_this_can_go_viral: The most defenseless victims (infants) + deliberate infection + lifelong quarantine = maximum dark curiosity.

title: The Doctor Who Planted Cancer Cells in Patients to 'Study Tumor Growth'
hook: He injected healthy patients with live cancer cells, told them it was a 'vaccine,' and watched the tumors grow.
why_this_can_go_viral: Deliberately giving someone cancer is the ultimate violation of 'do no harm'—pure horror story material.
